tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches active job listings on JobCrawls, an aggregator of jobs in Finland. The index covers jobs located in Finland plus remote roles open to Finland, and has no listings for other countries. Example queries: "find nurse jobs in Tampere", "onko Helsingissä avoimia etätyöpaikkoja ohjelmistokehittäjälle", "finns det lediga jobb som sjukskötare i Åbo". Inputs: a free-text query, facet filters (field, location, job type, seniority, skills, languages, industry, education and more), a remote-only flag, a salary floor, sort order and paging. Results, filter values and job text are in the language of the query when locale is omitted, or in the given locale. Output: a paginated list, each result with title, company, location, remoteness, salary range when known and a direct link to the posting. Valid filter values come from list_job_filters; the full text of a result comes from get_job_details. Listings sourced from Job Market Finland (Työmarkkinatori) have isTyomarkkinatori: true and include a dataSource attribution required by Job Market Finland's terms of use. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

query.description: Free-text search across job title, description, skills, company, and location. Example: "senior software engineer". Leave empty to browse the newest listings.

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language index to search: en = English, fi = Finnish, sv = Swedish. When omitted, results, filter values and job text come back in the language of "query" (detected from it); pass locale explicitly to override. Listing content AND filter values are localized per language, so filter values from list_job_filters match only under the same locale. "fi" has the broadest coverage of jobs in Finland.

filters.description: Facet filters keyed by attribute, each an array of allowed values (values within one attribute are OR-combined, with two exceptions: requiredLanguages takes the languages the user speaks and returns jobs that require no other language, so ["English", "Finnish"] means jobs needing only English, only Finnish, or both; benefits returns jobs with every listed benefit. Different attributes are AND-combined). Allowed keys: field, normalisedTitle, normalisedRoleLevel, location, companyIndustry, companyId, jobType, requiredLanguages, optionalLanguages, benefits, skillsAndTechnologies, educationLevel, peopleManagementTier, remoteness, regionTags, atsVendor. Values are case-sensitive and language-specific: they match only in the locale index list_job_filters returned them for (for example field is "Software Engineering" in en but its Finnish equivalent in fi). Example (en): { "field": ["Software Engineering"], "location": ["Helsinki, Finland"] }. regionTags takes the `placeId` of an entry in a previous result's `regions` (a Finnish region).

excludeFilters.description: Negative facet filters keyed by attribute, same shape as `filters` but EXCLUDES listings matching any of the given values instead of requiring them, for jobs that do not have a given attribute value. Allowed keys: field, normalisedTitle, normalisedRoleLevel, location, companyIndustry, companyId, jobType, requiredLanguages, optionalLanguages, benefits, skillsAndTechnologies, educationLevel, peopleManagementTier, remoteness, regionTags, atsVendor. Same locale rules as `filters` apply. Example (en): { "requiredLanguages": ["Finnish"] } returns jobs that do not require Finnish. A key present in both `filters` and `excludeFilters` is invalid.

remoteOnly.description: Shortcut for only fully remote positions (remoteness = Remote).

minSalary.description: Only listings whose minimum salary is at least this amount (listing currency, usually EUR).

sort.description: Ordering: relevance (default), date (newest first), or salary (highest minimum first).

includeFacets.description: When true, also return the facet values and counts for the current result set, plus `regions` (job counts per Finnish region). Default: false.

titleOnly.description: Match `query` against job titles only, not descriptions or skills, which counts ads that are for a role ("product manager" ads, not ads that mention products and managers). Default: false.

tools.name: list_job_filters
tools.description: Returns the facet attributes jobs can be filtered by (for example field, location, job type, seniority level, skills and languages), with the values currently present in active listings and how many listings have each value. The values are the exact strings search_jobs accepts in its `filters` parameter for the same locale. An optional query scopes the values to matching listings. Values are in the language of that query when locale is omitted, or in the given locale. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language index whose facet values to return: en = English, fi = Finnish, sv = Swedish. When omitted, the language of "query" (detected from it) is used. Values are localized and match search_jobs "filters" verbatim under the same locale.

query.description: Optional free-text query to scope the facet values to a subset of listings (e.g. only the facets present in "nurse" jobs). Leave empty for the whole active index.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Returns the complete details of one JobCrawls listing by its id (the `id` field of a search_jobs result): full description, requirements, responsibilities, benefits, salary, company, location, application deadline and a direct link to the posting. Listings sourced from Job Market Finland (Työmarkkinatori) have isTyomarkkinatori: true and include a dataSource attribution required by Job Market Finland's terms of use. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

jobId.description: The listing id (the `id` field returned by search_jobs). Required.

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language to return the listing content in: en = English, fi = Finnish, sv = Swedish, normally the locale of the search the id came from. This call has no query text to detect language from, so it defaults to en when omitted. If the listing is not available in that language the connector falls back to whichever language it exists in.

tools.name: calculate_net_salary_finland
tools.description: Gross-to-net salary calculator for Finland, from the JobCrawls tax iceberg calculator. Example queries: "what is 4000 gross net in Finland", "paljonko jää käteen 4200 euron bruttopalkasta Helsingissä", "vad blir nettolönen på 3800 brutto i Helsingfors". Inputs: a gross salary (EUR per month by default, or per year), or a target net to solve the gross it takes, and optionally the municipality, employer size, age, dependent children, commuting costs and investment income. Church membership and union fees are not inputs. The linked page is in the language detected from "municipality" when locale is omitted, else English, or in the given locale. Returns monthly and annual breakdowns: employee pension and unemployment contributions, state, municipal, church and Yle taxes, net pay, employer contributions and the true cost of employment, plus the effective tax rate, the assumptions used and a link to the same scenario on jobcrawls.com. Uses the current tax year's official Finnish parameters; an estimate, not tax advice. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

gross.description: Gross salary in euros, per month unless period is "year". Either gross or net is required.

net.description: Target net pay in euros (same period): the tool solves the gross salary that leaves this in hand. Either gross or net is required.

period.description: Period of every money amount given. Default month.

locale.description: Language of the user's message (fi for Finnish, sv for Swedish, en for English or any other language), including when job titles or place names in it are English. Language of the result notes, the inline card and the linked page. When omitted, detected from "municipality" if it is given in Finnish or Swedish form; otherwise defaults to en.

municipality.description: Finnish municipality, by its Finnish or Swedish name, e.g. "Helsinki", "Helsingfors" or "Espoo". Omit for the national-average municipal tax rate.

employerSize.description: Employer payroll size for the unemployment-insurance rate (large = payroll above about EUR 2.5 million). Omit for a blended average.

includeVat.description: Also subtract the VAT paid when the net is spent (an estimate). Default false.

age.description: Age in years, affects pension and unemployment contributions.

dependentChildren.description: Number of dependent children, affects the child tax deduction.

isSoleGuardian.description: Single parent with dependent children (child deduction).

commutingCosts.description: Commuting costs in the same period; deductible above the own-liability share, capped.

dividends.description: Listed-company dividends in the same period (capital income).

capitalGains.description: Capital gains net of acquisition cost in the same period.

unlistedDividends.description: Dividends from the person's own unlisted company in the same period (8% yield rule).

unlistedNetAssets.description: Mathematical value of the person's shares in that company, EUR (a stock, not per period).

keyEmployee.description: Key employee source tax (avainhenkilön lähdevero): 25% flat on gross from 2026 instead of progressive tax, for people who moved to Finland for expert work (at least EUR 5,800 a month, not resident in Finland in the previous 5 years, first 84 months). Default false.
